title: Assembly of compatible coefficient-level isomorphisms
statement:
variable {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
  [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C]
  (B : ℕ → Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
  (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n)


theorem systemIsoOfEvaluation_exists
    {M N : Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ}
    (δ : ∀ n : ℕ, (evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj M ≅
      (evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj N)
    (ht : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
      (transition.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h).app M ≫
          (res.{c, v, max c v r} (coefficientMap.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h)).map (δ n).hom =
        (δ m).hom ≫ (transition.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h).app N) :
    ∃ e : M ≅ N, ∀ n : ℕ,
      (evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).map e.hom = (δ n).hom

source.place: Tag 03D1, morphisms of sheaves of modules; Zheng Construction 4.1, systems as module sheaves on the product site.

proof.text: Undo the evaluation ring identification using its inverse ring isomorphism. A linear map after restriction along a ring isomorphism is linear for the original ring; its underlying function is unchanged. This constructs maps on the actual component modules.

The given component morphisms are vertically natural. The actual transition normalization converts the assumed horizontal square into horizontal naturality. Factor any arrow of the product category as a vertical arrow followed by a horizontal arrow to obtain a module-sheaf morphism. Its evaluation has exactly the prescribed component map.

Evaluations are jointly faithful by sectionwise extensionality. On the abelian category of systems they therefore jointly reflect isomorphisms: they jointly reflect monomorphisms and epimorphisms, and the category is balanced. The assembled map is invertible since every component is an isomorphism.
